note: Act III, level 3-06. Babel memory of the Loud Wars, wordless, skippable, under 30 s. Captions are for the artist and are never shown. No legible text in any still.

stills.caption_for_artist: A feed scrolling faster than a person can read, a blur of grey panels and flickering periwinkle light. No legible words.
A child shouting at a glowing screen, face lit from below, fists tight.
A soldier at the edge of a ruined street, holding a phone in both hands, looking at it instead of ahead.
A quiet room after: a cold cup, an empty chair, dust in a thin shaft of light. Nothing moves.
A first dictionary opens on a desk. One word is written on the page in amber ink, too small to read, in handwriting the player has seen on Rhee cards.
